# `company.pick_list_revisions`

Append-only pick list revisions: open, then done or cancelled; the newest is current.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this revision. |
| `pick_list_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with pick_list_id + revision_number | — | pick_lists.id | Pick list this revision restates. |
| `revision_number` | INTEGER | no | — | unique with pick_list_id + revision_number | — | — | One-based revision number; the newest is current and is the version. |
| `status` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | — | — | open, done or cancelled. |
| `reason` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Why this revision was written, as the caller gave it. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this pick list revision was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that recorded this pick list revision. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that recorded this pick list revision. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this pick list revision. |
